description: This Java class defines the 'FeaturePropertyCreated' event, which is emitted after a feature's property of a thing is created. It includes methods for constructing instances, JSON serialization/deserialization, and accessors for event details.

classes.name: FeaturePropertyCreated
classes.description: Immutable event class representing the creation of a feature property, with JSON serialization/deserialization, and methods for event handling.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Constructs a new FeaturePropertyCreated instance with specified parameters, including optional timestamp and metadata.

methods.description: Creates an instance from a JSON string or JSON object, with associated headers.

methods.description: Returns the ID of the feature associated with the event.

methods.name: getPropertyValue
methods.description: Returns the value of the created property.
